newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 26,300 slaughter steers and 17,000 heifers; 160,600 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,300 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - All cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 70.00-70.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 70.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1000- 1100 lbs including heiferettes 68.00-69.00.
Wk to date - 160,600 Week Ago - 18,800 Year Ago - 55,800
